content.text: Karol G Spent 3 Times Her Coachella Pay on Her 2026 Headlining SetKarol G reportedly went all out for her 2026 Coachella Music Festival performance this year.The 35-year-old Tropicoqueta Colombian superstar is helming the Sunday headlining slot for this year’s festival in Indio, Calif.And according to her team, she spent around three times what she was paid by the festival to bring her headlining set to life.Keep reading to find out more…While her exact salary has not been confirmed, Coachella headliners typically earn several million dollars, or “in the mid-seven figures,” per THR.But Karol G invested far beyond that into the show, pouring major money into the production, including visuals, rehearsals and staging, in order to create...Den vollständigen Artikel findest du unter Just Jared16.4.2026von Just JaredJust JaredÄhnliche NeuigkeitenKarol GKarol G Has Officially Announced Her Global Tropitour21.4.2026von Maya GeorgiRollingstone.comKarol G Announces 'Viajando Por El Mundo Tropitour' Tour 2026: How to Buy Tickets21.4.2026von Just JaredJust JaredSpotifyJesser makes moves off the court to turn his sports content empire into a business17.4.2026von Sam GutelleTubefilter.comCrunchyroll Announces Witch Chat: The Official Witch Hat Atelier Companion Podcast16.4.2026von Crunchyroll OfficialCrunchyrollSpotify and Big 3 Record Labels Win $322 Million Decision Against Pirate Group Anna’s Archive [Updated]16.4.2026von Wren GravesConsequence - MusicJbeau LewisUTA Promotes 26 Employees in Largest Partner Class in Agency’s History31.5.2022von Angelique JacksonVariety Film + TVUTA Promotes 26 To Partner Marking Largest Partner Promotions In Agency’s History31.5.2022von Justin KrollDeadline Film + TVIMDb.com, Inc. übernimmt keine Verantwortung für den Inhalt oder die Richtigkeit der oben genannten Nachrichtenartikel, Tweets oder Blog-Beiträge.
